phrases.cap: Back in the late 1800s,|Charles Fey built|the Liberty Bell,|a machine with|three spinning reels.

phrases.say: In Pennsylvania, the rules say the result is chosen when each play begins.
phrases.cap: In Pennsylvania, the rules say|the result is chosen|when each play begins.

sources.name: Wikipedia, Slot machine (Charles Fey's Liberty Bell, three reels, between 1887 and 1895; random number generators; payout set at the factory when the software is written, operator chooses the chip; minimum payout Nevada 75%, New Jersey 83%)

Pennsylvania Code, 58 Pa. Code 461a.7 Slot machine minimum design standards (theoretical payout may not be less than 85%; outcome selected by a random number generator at the initiation of each play; display an accurate representation of the selected outcome)
Wikipedia, Return to player (90% payout means $90 returned for every $100 bet)

post.instagram_caption:
Who decides how much a slot machine pays back? Not luck.

A random number generator picks each result, and the payback percentage is set in the software before you play. The law only sets a minimum: 75% in Nevada, 83% in New Jersey, 85% in Pennsylvania.

Education only. Not gambling advice. 18+
